title: CloakPipe manifest (cloakpipe.manifest.yaml)
description: The single-file manifest the CloakPipe tool gate runs on: which tools an agent release may call, what each call may carry, which calls have side effects, and which need a signed approval. Closed by default: a tool that is not declared is refused (undeclared_tool), and so is an argument not declared under its tool (undeclared_argument). The manifest digest is sha256 over the RFC 8785 (JCS) encoding of the parsed document; a referenced policy file is digested separately over its bytes. Semantic checks the schema cannot express (patterns compile, keywords match the constraint's type, a constraint restricts something, idempotency_key templates and approval.when conditions parse and use declared arguments, side_effect and effect agree, idempotency_key only on side-effecting tools, duplicate keys) are enforced by the CloakPipe loader.

release.description: The release name: the agent this manifest is for.

version.description: The release version. Quote it in YAML when it could read as a number ("1.10").

policy.description: Optional path to a Cedar policy file, relative to the manifest's directory.

tools.description: The tools the release may call, by name as in tools/call.

args.description: The arguments a call may carry. Absent: the tool takes no arguments.

side_effect.description: The call changes state outside the agent: it is an operation, tracked in the operations store so it is never silently re-executed. true is effect: write.

effect.description: What the call does to the world. write and irreversible are side effects.

idempotency_key.description: Side-effecting tools only. A template naming the operation: literal text with {path}, {task.path} and {sha256(path)} placeholders over the call's arguments and the trusted task context, e.g. "{ticket_id}:{sha256(body)}".

approval.description: The call needs a signed approval receipt for its exact arguments.

when.description: Approval is needed only when this holds: comparisons `path OP literal` (OP one of > >= < <= == !=; literal a number, a quoted string, true or false) joined by && and || with parentheses. A comparison that meets a missing value or another type holds. Absent: always.

approvers.description: Free-form routes for an approval broker (e.g. slack:#support-leads), reported in the approval_required refusal with the call fingerprint.

ttl.description: The longest validity window (notAfter - approvedAt) a receipt may carry, e.g. 15m, 1h30m, 1d.

show.description: Top-level arguments (declared under args) whose values an approval broker may see in a request, e.g. [amount, ticket_id]. Default: none; no other value is ever sent. Use sparingly: a call fingerprint over low-entropy arguments can be guessed.

arg.description: One argument's constraint. Optional unless required: true.

pattern.description: A regex the whole string must match (anchored).

min_len.description: Minimum length (Unicode scalars; items for an array).

max_len.description: Maximum length (Unicode scalars; items for an array).

one_of_context.description: Dotted paths into the trusted task context (a task. prefix is accepted). The value must equal one of their values, each a string or an array of strings.

or_pattern.description: With one_of_context: a regex (unanchored search) that also lets a string through.
